evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal fibers with bowing related to medial meniscus extrusion.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Extensive complex tear at the posterior horn and body of medial meniscus with maceration and extrusion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Full thickness cartilage denudation throughout the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with subchondral cystic change and marrow edema.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the anterior weightbearing surfaces. High grade chondrosis along the peripheral lateral joint.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the medial trochlea.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
